data.hook: A super-light, round junior racket that makes learning padel easy.
why: Light 310–330 g build for small hands and quick reactions
Round shape with a central sweet spot for control
Soft fibreglass face and EVA Soft Performance core for comfort
Exoskeleton structure for stiffness and durability
Adjustable cord for a secure fit on smaller wrists
data.playStyle: Kids and juniors starting out or playing regularly, who need a light, forgiving racket.
data.summary: The Arrow Hit Junior is made for the youngest players: a super-light round racket with the sweet spot in the centre for control, and a soft fibreglass face that is easy on growing arms.
data.description:
Lightweight for quick movements, the Arrow Hit Junior helps kids learn good technique without fighting the racket. The round head keeps the sweet spot central and forgiving, and the soft EVA core and fibreglass face add comfort.

An exoskeleton structure keeps it stiff and durable, and the adjustable cord gives a better hold on smaller wrists.

tech.name: Exoskeleton structure
tech.text: Increases stiffness and resistance to twisting.

tech.name: Smart Holes Curve
tech.text: Hole pattern designed to help generate spin.

tech.name: EVA Soft Performance
tech.text: Soft core for comfort and control.

tech.name: Adjustable cord
tech.text: Wrist cord that adjusts for a secure grip.

faq.a: Junior players. It suits most kids from around 7–8 up to early teens. Bring your child in to check the size.
It is designed and sized for juniors, so adults will find it too light.

faq.q: Does it come in other colours?
faq.a: This listing is the white/pink version.

data.clubTake: Brand new. Perfect for our junior sessions. Light enough that kids can swing it properly from day one.
